biggest_catch: The $25 is paid 90 days after the new account is opened, and the new customer MUST mention your name at the time of account opening - a retroactive referral claim does not qualify.
catches: Only Premier Community Bank customers in good standing who are at least 18 years of age may participate.
The referred individual cannot be an existing customer and cannot have closed an account at Premier Community Bank within the last 12 months.
A checking account must be opened for the referral to qualify; all new accounts are subject to the bank's normal approval process.
The new customer MUST mention the referrer's name at the time of account opening for each to receive a $25 reward.
The $25 reward will be paid 90 days after the new account is open, deposited into the account; if the referring customer does not have a deposit account, they must open one.
Premier Community Bank reserves the right to end the Refer-A-Friend program at any time without notice.

steps: Refer a friend or family member to Premier Community Bank.
Friend opens a checking account and mentions your name at account opening.
Receive a $25 reward per referral, paid 90 days after the new account is open.
timing: $25 reward paid 90 days after the new account is open, deposited into the account.
when_cash_arrives: $25 reward paid 90 days after the new account is open, deposited into the account. Terms impose a fixed waiting period after the friend's account opens - nothing arrives before that date.
maximize: Refer early and have your friend complete ALL qualifying activity in the first days of the window - late qualification pushes the fixed payout date even further out.
Both accounts must stay open and in good standing through the entire wait - early closure forfeits the bonus.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: the program's terms lock payout to a fixed date (60-120 days out) regardless of how fast your friend qualifies.
